derivation:
obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ_surjective I (AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ I x)
refine ⟨a, ?_⟩; rw [← AdicCompletion.ker_evalOneₐ_eq_map (I := I) I.fg, RingHom.mem_ker]; simpa [map_sub, AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ_of] using ha.symm
explanation: Mathlib proves that the kernel of evaluation at level one is exactly the image of I in the completion. Choose a so that `of I A a` and x have the same level-one evaluation; their difference is then in that kernel. The target proof instead uses exactness of adic completion.
